description: This file defines the internal server API for media key decryption in Rialto, including interfaces for creating media key instances, decrypting buffers, and managing sessions. It declares classes, methods, and constants related to encrypted media content handling.

classes.name: IMediaKeysServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaKeysServerInternal based on key system.

classes.name: IMediaKeysServerInternal
classes.description: Interface defining the server internal API for media key decryption, including methods for decrypting buffers and session management.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaKeysServerInternalFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaKeysServerInternal
methods.description: Creates a new IMediaKeysServerInternal instance for a specified key system.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted buffer using a session ID, with an option for deprecated decryption method.

methods.name: hasSession
methods.description: Checks if a session with the given ID is handled by this media keys instance.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if the key system for a session is PlayReady.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Increments the usage counter for a session ID.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Decrements the usage counter for a session ID.
